title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Where Another Contract Covers the Work
content:
The rate program does not decide by itself what a call costs when the building is also under a
maintenance agreement.

**Where the agreement covers the repair.** Where the unit called about sits on an active maintenance
agreement whose tier covers repair labor, the repair is handled under that agreement and its allowance,
and the demand program bills nothing for the labor; the demand rates apply only to work the agreement
does not cover. The agreement, its standing and the tier it is held at are read from the customer's
Preventive Maintenance Agreements records against the building the call was worked at, not from what the
caller says is covered.

**Where the agreement does not cover the repair.** Where the tier allows rate substitution and the unit
sits on a maintenance agreement that does not cover the repair, the lower of the agreement's labor rate
and this program's labor rate governs the labor line. Where the tier does not allow rate substitution,
this program's rate governs, because at those tiers the rate is already below every agreement rate the
company publishes.

**Where a retrofit project is in progress.** A building whose calls are dispatched under an equipment
retrofit project in progress is billed to that project and not to this program, and the desk never
splits one work order between the two.

**Where both would cover an emergency dispatch.** Emergency allowance and maintenance emergency
entitlements do not stack: where both would cover the same dispatch, the maintenance entitlement is
drawn first and the program allowance is left untouched.

### Points of judgement

| What the records show | What governs the labor line under the Demand Service Rate Programs |
|---|---|
| an active maintenance agreement at the building whose tier covers repair labor | the agreement and its allowance; the demand program bills nothing for the labor |
| an active maintenance agreement at the building that does not cover the repair, the program's tier allowing rate substitution | the lower of the agreement's labor rate and this program's labor rate |
| an active maintenance agreement at the building that does not cover the repair, the program's tier not allowing rate substitution | this program's rate |
| calls dispatched under an equipment retrofit project in progress | the project, not this program |
